title: Void Kiwi
description: A Mod that adds stuff i want too and Void stuff
body:
**This is a really basic Mod and not finished!**



**Some Items are not in survival archivabel.**


This mod aims to add Void based Items and blocks with custom effects. It aims to be just a tiny mod that adds stuff for survival progression in big modpacks.



The mod adds various items like:

Void diamonds: craftable into void diamond blocks and Void Tools/Armor

Void goo: craftable into VOID and Void Bricks

Void Staff: turns some blocks (like stone) into void blocks

Void altar: turns items thrown on top into void items (diamonds -> void diamonds, ...)

Void berry: a berry that when consumed gives high saturation but a 50% chance of getting the darkness effect (with bushes)

Ores: ore blocks for void goo and diamonds (deepslate, normal) (spawn naturally)
